title: Release Manifest
description: What a published contracts release declares about itself: which commit produced it, which contracts it carries, and the checksums that make a consumer's pin verifiable. This contract is defined before the manifest is generated so the release tooling produces a document conforming to an existing contract rather than defining the shape by accident.

repository.title: Producing repository
repository.description: Always this repository. Fixed so a manifest cannot be mistaken for one produced elsewhere.

version.title: Release version
version.description: The released version. Immutable: a correction is a new version, never an edit to this one.

commit_sha.title: Source commit
commit_sha.description: The full git commit the release was built from, so the artifact can be traced to reviewable source.

built_at_utc.title: Build timestamp
built_at_utc.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC with a literal 'Z' offset.

contracts.title: Released contracts
contracts.description: Every contract carried by this release, each with the checksum of its source.

bundle_sha256.title: Bundle checksum
bundle_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bundle archive this manifest describes. A consumer's pin is checked against this value.

governance_version.title: Governance generation
governance_version.description: Which generation of the governance rules the release was produced under, so a gate can tell whether a release predates a policy change.

compatibility_result.title: Compatibility verdict
compatibility_result.description: The verdict carried by this release, mirroring compatibility-result.v1. A release may not be published on a 'fail' verdict; 'no-baseline' means no prior release existed to compare against and confers no compatibility guarantee.

released_contract.title: Released contract entry
released_contract.description: One contract as published, carrying everything a consumer needs to verify it without reading the bundle.

source.description: Repository-relative path to the contract source within the bundle.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the contract source file, so a single contract can be verified without rehashing the whole bundle.
